title: CAT 2022 Question Paper (Slot 1, PYQ) - Quantitative Ability - Time, Speed, and Distance
subject: Quantitative Ability

questions.q: Trains A and B start traveling at the same time towards each other with constant speeds from stations X and Y, respectively. Train A reaches station Y in 10 minutes while train B takes 9 minutes to reach station X after meeting train A. Then the total time taken, in minutes, by train B to travel from station Y to station X is
questions.explain: Let the trains meet after $t$ minutes. Train A takes $10 - t$ minutes to complete the rest of the journey. For crossing paths, we know the relation $\frac{t_A}{t_B} = \frac{\text{time B takes after meeting}}{\text{time A takes after meeting}}$. Based on the equations, Train B total time solves to exactly 15 minutes.
